items.title: Conference champions
items.note: Beat City University 78–71 in the final. Daniel Okafor named finals MVP.

items.title: National semi-finalist
items.note: First national semi-final in club history. Lost by four to the eventual champions.

items.title: Conference runners-up
items.note: A rebuild season that ended one game short. Nine returning players the year after.

items.title: Conference champions
items.note: Undefeated at home. The defence allowed under 60 points in six straight games.

items.title: Regional champions
items.note: Won the regional invitational in overtime after a 19-point comeback.

items.title: National quarter-finalist
items.note: Second national tournament appearance. The club's best defensive rating to date.

items.title: Conference champions
items.note: Club-record 21 wins. Five players finished the season in double figures.

items.title: League champions
items.note: The first title after the club moved to the regional league structure.

items.title: Regional runners-up
items.note: Lost the final by two. The squad that convinced the university to fund travel.

items.title: First national appearance
items.note: A wildcard invitation after winning 16 of 18 games. The start of the modern era.
